PyCon.DE 2016 Munich
2016-10-28 – 2016-10-30 · Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität, Munich
Sessions (31)
Speakers (30)
The 2016 edition of PyCon.DE took place 28–30 October 2016 in Munich. Every session is listed below, with the speakers on their own page — every session was recorded and is hosted by LMU Munich.
